key_insight: Distributed quantum computing needs online scheduling that responds to circuit arrivals without knowing future demand.
engineering_relevance: Quantum cloud systems must balance latency and throughput while managing limited memory, unreliable entanglement generation, and decoherence.
method: Formalize online circuit scheduling and distribution over quantum networks.
At each arrival or completion, select waiting circuits to launch and place their qubits.
Account for in-flight congestion and physical constraints while targeting mean completion time and makespan.
evidence_signal: The abstract describes the problem formulation but reports no datasets, evaluation results, or quantitative performance gains.
watch_item: Practical performance and stability under varying loads remain unverified by the abstract.
paper_title: Online Scheduling and Distribution of Quantum Circuits over Quantum Networks
